tasks.title: Parser tolerance and caps
tasks.prompt: In lib/services/audio/midi/smf_song_parser.dart (parseSmfSong): (1) do NOT throw when the header track count differs from the number of MTrk chunks actually found (real files lie): accept whatever MTrk chunks exist, but still throw FormatException if zero MTrk chunks. (2) For format 0 do not require trackCount==1. Keep rejecting SMPTE timing, format 2, bad header, truncated data. (3) Add hard caps: throw FormatException('Too many notes') when total notes exceed 200000 and FormatException('Too many tracks') when resulting tracks exceed 64. (4) Add a doc comment on parseSmfSong stating that a track's program is the program active at that channel's first note and later program changes are ignored. Update tests in test/midi/smf_song_parser_test.dart: replace any test asserting a track-count-mismatch throw with one asserting it parses; add tests for the two caps (build large fixtures programmatically) and for zero-MTrk failure. Do not touch parseDrumSmf behavior.
